items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: James McNeil was the best musician, trumpet player that we ever turned out in New Orleans.

ctx.x: Loud. Was that triple tone? Could he do triple tone?

Yeah, he could do triple tone. Buddy Bolton. Yeah. He was a cracker jack in that day. And loud, and loud with it. James McNeil was the greatest. James McNeil was the best musician, trumpet player that we ever turned out in New Orleans. I guess you know of him, don't you? James McNeil. He was the master. James McNeil.
